name: lightroom-mcp
description: Bridge Claude to Adobe Lightroom Classic — search, organize, develop, export.
long_description: Connects Claude to a running Adobe Lightroom Classic instance via a bundled Lua plugin. Tools cover catalog search, collections, ratings, keywords, develop presets and settings, import and export. The Lightroom plugin is auto-installed into Lightroom's Modules folder on first run; restart Lightroom once after install to load it.

tools.name: search_photos
tools.description: Search the catalog by filename, keywords, rating, or date.

tools.name: get_selected_photos
tools.description: Photos currently selected in Lightroom (or the filmstrip).

tools.name: get_photo_metadata
tools.description: Detailed metadata for one photo_id or up to 100 photo_ids; sections: ["developSettings"] includes develop settings for each.

tools.name: get_photo_preview
tools.description: Get a JPEG preview of a photo as an image.

tools.name: get_photo_previews
tools.description: Get up to 20 ordered JPEG thumbnails for first-pass culling.

tools.name: find_duplicate_groups
tools.description: Find read-only duplicate and burst groups using preview similarity and raw capture time

tools.name: get_photo_stats
tools.description: Read histogram, clipping and sharpness from rendered previews for up to 20 photos.

tools.name: set_gps
tools.description: Set the GPS position of photos.

tools.name: set_location
tools.description: Set the IPTC location fields of photos.

tools.name: set_ai_metadata
tools.description: Store or clear private AI scores and reasons in the catalog

tools.name: get_ai_metadata
tools.description: Read private AI scores and reasons for a batch of photos

tools.name: set_metadata
tools.description: Set title, caption, headline, creator and copyright fields of photos.

tools.name: list_folders
tools.description: List catalog folders with full paths and direct photo counts.

tools.name: get_folder_photos
tools.description: List photos in a folder, optionally including subfolders.

tools.name: list_collections
tools.description: List all collections and collection sets.

tools.name: create_smart_collection
tools.description: Save search filters as a smart collection

tools.name: create_collection
tools.description: Create a new collection.

tools.name: add_to_collection
tools.description: Add photos to an existing collection.

tools.name: get_collection_photos
tools.description: List the photos in a collection, regular or smart.

tools.name: remove_from_collection
tools.description: Remove photos from a collection.

tools.name: delete_collection
tools.description: Delete a collection; its photos stay in the catalog.

tools.name: set_keywords
tools.description: Add or remove keywords on photos, by name or hierarchy path.

tools.name: remove_keyword_subtree
tools.description: Detach a parent keyword and its descendants from photos; keyword nodes stay in the catalog.

tools.name: list_keywords
tools.description: List the keyword hierarchy as full paths.

tools.name: rename_keyword
tools.description: Rename a keyword everywhere it is used.

tools.name: undo_last_step
tools.description: Undo one shared Lightroom history step, including user actions, with confirm: true.

tools.name: set_rating_and_flag
tools.description: Set star rating, pick flag, or both on photos.

tools.name: remove_photos_from_catalog
tools.description: Remove specified photos from the catalog with explicit confirmation; keep files on disk (Lightroom Classic 14.3+)

tools.name: set_color_label
tools.description: Set or clear color labels on photos.

tools.name: import_photos
tools.description: Import photos into the catalog.

tools.name: export_photos
tools.description: Export photos with format/quality/dimensions.

tools.name: export_photo_metadata
tools.description: Write metadata for many photos to a JSON file.

tools.name: list_develop_presets
tools.description: List available Develop presets.

tools.name: get_develop_preset
tools.description: Read the settings and backing-file metadata for one exact Develop preset.

tools.name: compare_develop_presets
tools.description: Compare two Develop presets and return a deterministic per-setting diff for iterative style matching.

tools.name: create_develop_preset
tools.description: Create a versioned plugin-managed Develop preset checkpoint from selected settings on one photo.

tools.name: export_develop_preset
tools.description: Copy one exact custom or plugin-managed Develop preset backing file to a destination directory.

tools.name: apply_develop_preset
tools.description: Apply a Develop preset to photos.

tools.name: copy_develop_settings
tools.description: Copy Develop settings from one photo to others.

tools.name: match_photo_style
tools.description: Match a reference photo's global style after a confirmed snapshot, preserving framing, white balance, lens corrections and masks.

tools.name: set_develop_settings
tools.description: Set Develop settings directly on a photo.

tools.name: get_lens_blur
tools.description: Read Lens Blur state and controls on one photo (Lightroom Classic 13.3+).

tools.name: set_lens_blur
tools.description: Set Lens Blur controls with ordered activation and saved readback (Lightroom Classic 13.3+).

tools.name: set_process_version
tools.description: Set photos to Lightroom Version 1 through Version 6 with confirmation

tools.name: apply_auto_adjustments
tools.description: Apply Lightroom Auto Tone, Auto White Balance, or both to photos.

tools.name: reset_develop_adjustments
tools.description: Reset all develop adjustments; requires confirmation. Recover edits through Lightroom History.

tools.name: apply_denoise
tools.description: Turn on AI Denoise at a given amount on photos.

tools.name: list_masks
tools.description: List the masks on a photo with their ids, names, component tools and stored ranges.

tools.name: create_gradient_mask
tools.description: Place a linear or radial gradient mask on a photo from normalized image coordinates.

tools.name: update_gradient_mask
tools.description: Move or reshape an existing linear or radial gradient mask by tool id.

tools.name: create_brush_mask
tools.description: Paint a brush mask on a photo from strokes of normalized image coordinates (radius, flow, feather, density, erase).

tools.name: add_brush_strokes
tools.description: Paint more strokes into an existing brush mask by tool id (radius, flow, feather, density, erase).

tools.name: create_range_mask
tools.description: Create a luminance, color or depth range mask on a photo, as a new mask or a component of one.

tools.name: delete_masks
tools.description: Delete masks or components on one photo, or empty masks from a photo list.

tools.name: set_mask_adjustments
tools.description: Change local adjustment sliders on an existing mask of a photo.

tools.name: get_mask
tools.description: Read selected local mask adjustments, curves and Point Color in one Develop session

tools.name: invert_mask
tools.description: Invert a mask on a photo in place, or create an inverted copy of it.

tools.name: create_mask
tools.description: Create Subject, Sky, Background, People parts or Landscape category masks

tools.name: create_mask_batch
tools.description: Add the same Subject, Sky or Background mask to many photos, each recomputed for its own photo.

tools.name: set_mask_curves
tools.description: Set the local tone curve of a mask on a photo, per channel.

tools.name: edit_mask_point_colors
tools.description: Add, update, delete or clear the local Point Color swatches of a mask.

tools.name: combine_mask
tools.description: Add, subtract or intersect a Subject, Sky or Background component on an existing mask.

tools.name: list_develop_snapshots
tools.description: List saved develop snapshots for a photo

tools.name: create_virtual_copies
tools.description: Create virtual copies and restore the previous selection

tools.name: create_develop_snapshot
tools.description: Save current develop settings as a named snapshot

tools.name: apply_develop_snapshot
tools.description: Restore saved develop settings from a snapshot

tools.name: delete_develop_snapshot
tools.description: Delete one saved develop snapshot

tools.name: summarize_develop_settings
tools.description: Summarize numeric Develop settings by camera and ISO for rated or exported photos

tools.name: list_spots
tools.description: List Remove spots and SDK parameters

tools.name: update_spot
tools.description: Update a Heal spot Opacity

tools.name: delete_spot
tools.description: Delete a Remove spot by index

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: List and accept only read tools from the enabled toolsets. File exports are blocked. Restart the server after changing this setting.

toolsets.title: Enabled toolsets
toolsets.description: Core catalog tools are always enabled. Add develop, masks, develop,masks, or all. Restart the server after changing this setting.

request_port.title: Plugin request port
request_port.description: TCP port the Lightroom plugin listens on for requests. Must match the Plug-in Manager setting.

response_port.title: Plugin response port
response_port.description: TCP port the Lightroom plugin sends responses on. Must match the Plug-in Manager setting.
